title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Posture Agent in DSPM
summary: Hold: the capacity-management note omits the Security Copilot owner permission needed to change capacity in Security Copilot. The briefing also treats coverage by the E5 included allocation as unresolved, although Microsoft's inclusion page covers all Purview agentic scenarios. The roadmap facts and the flagged deactivation path are supported.

claims.claim: The Data Security Posture Agent is a Security Copilot agent in Microsoft Purview DSPM.
claims.quote: Microsoft Security Copilot agents are AI-powered processes that help you with specific role-based tasks. Microsoft Purview offers: ... Data Security Posture Management posture agent in preview

claims.quote: Instead of relying on keyword- or filter-based search tools, it uses large language models (LLMs) to understand user intent. ... The experience includes a concise summary and an associated risk analysis generated by the LLM.

claims.quote: It's designed for pre-investigation checks rather than formal cases that still require other Microsoft Purview solutions, such as eDiscovery, audit, and Data Security Investigations.

Remove those checklist bullets; retain their already documented facts in Scope, Risk assessment and Cost and licensing. Do not add rows as part of this correction.
